description: List the live state of every open pull request against Chia-Network/chips that adds or modifies a CHIP file. Use this for PR review context (author, requested reviewers, draft flag, updated_at) and the modifies_existing flag for amendments. PRs that do not touch a CHIPs/chip-*.md file are filtered out. For the canonical CHIP index across all statuses (including Draft proposals), use list_chips.
name: list_chip_drafts
